correctness.rationale: The type-A root polytope P_n=conv{e_i-e_j} is the simplex difference body with facets sum_{i in S}x_i<=1. At root e_i-e_j, a direction v illuminates iff v_i<0<v_j and -v_i+v_j>T(v)=sum_{v_l>0}v_l. Two illuminated roots with distinct tails and heads would contradict the two available sign masses, hence an illuminated graph is a star of size at most n-1. Explicit n full tail stars cover the boundary, while fractional vertex-coverage summation yields lower bound n. Equality forces all positive-weight directions to be full stars; off-diagonal constraints alpha_i+beta_j=1 on connected K_{n,n} minus a matching give alpha_i=t,beta_j=1-t. This establishes exact I=I*=n and the stated optimizer rigidity for n>=3. The complete earlier 2026-10-25 proof was inspected and contains precisely the same argument and quantifiers. Source integer checker also independently inspected; independent small-dimensional active-facet reasoning corroborated the star criterion.
